==Behind the scenes==
Plasti-foil was first mentioned in [[Christopher Kubasik]]'s [[1989]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|Crisis on Cloud City]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Cloud" /> [[Republic Commando: Triple Zero|''Triple Zero'']], the [[2006]] second entry in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series of novels by [[Karen Traviss]], later introduced the alternate spelling "plastifoil" that was used in the name of the [[thermal plastifoil survival blanket]].<ref name="TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
